title: Observe European packed lookup in F09 combat
changes: Record a bounded negative observation for the EUR packed lookup during an existing F09 confirmed Fight.
validation: One Wine production run of the existing 500-frame state and input reports zero packed lookup reads; 206 guarded files and 695 frozen source hashes stayed unchanged.
limitations: This is a scene-limited negative, not a proof of global absence; positive ordinary use, Linux, USA and native Windows remain open. No performance measurements.
